definitions.explanation: An occasion when people come together. An assembly or get-together.
A set of things or people gathered in one place.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{集|あつ}まりがある。
{集|あつ}まりが{悪|わる}いですね。
{友達|ともだち}の{集|あつ}まりに{参加|さんか}しました。
examples.english: I participated in a friends' gathering.

examples.japanese: {良|よ}い{人|ひと}の{集|あつ}まりです。
examples.english: It's a group of good people.

examples.japanese: このクラスは{色々|いろいろ}な{国|くに}の{人|ひと}の{集|あつ}まりだ。
examples.english: This class is a collection of people from various countries.

examples.japanese: あの{会社|かいしゃ}は{優秀|ゆうしゅう}な{人|ひと}の{集|あつ}まりだと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: That company is said to be a group of talented people.

notes:
{集|あつ}まり is the noun form of {集|あつ}まる (to gather).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {人|ひと}の{集|あつ}まり (a gathering of people)
- {集|あつ}まりが{良|よ}い/{悪|わる}い (good/poor turnout)
- {集|あつ}まりに{参加|さんか}する (participate in a gathering)

RELATED WORDS:
- {集|あつ}まる: to gather (intransitive verb)
- {集|あつ}める: to collect (transitive verb)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {会合|かいごう}: meeting (formal)
- {集|あつ}まり: gathering (casual)
- {集会|しゅうかい}: assembly, rally
